memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow-up for irritable bowel syndrome.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports intermittent abdominal bloating and loose stools for 2 weeks, no blood or weight loss.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 155 cm, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Abdomen soft, non-tender, no masses.
IMPRESSION: IBS stable. Overweight per Asian cut‑offs; advise reduced refined carbs, daily walk 30 min. Ordered CBC, stool routine, tTG‑IgA to exclude coeliac and anaemia.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Return if fever >39°C, bloody stools, worsening pain, or vomiting.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Mebeverine hydrochloride 135 mg tablet – take one tablet twice daily.
Ispaghula husk 5 g sachet – take one sachet once daily with water.
Loperamide 2 mg capsule – take up to two capsules after loose stool, max 8 mg/day.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.8 g/L (12.0‑15.5), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4.0‑10.0), Plt 210 x10^9/L (150‑400).
Stool routine: No ova, cysts, or pus cells; negative for occult blood.
tTG‑IgA: 4 U/mL (<7 negative).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
IBS review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Bloating improved, occasional urgency after meals.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/80, weight 57.5 kg, BMI 23.9 (overweight). Abdomen benign.
IMPRESSION: Symptom control adequate. Overweight persists; reinforce low‑FODMAP diet, increase water intake.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Return if new rectal bleeding, weight loss, or pain waking at night.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Mebeverine hydrochloride 135 mg tablet – BD.
Ispaghula husk 5 g sachet – OD.
Loperamide 2 mg capsule – SOS, max 8 mg/24h.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No new GI symptoms; asks about cholesterol.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/84, weight 58 kg, BMI 24.1 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: IBS quiescent. Overweight; advise Mediterranean‑style diet, brisk walk 4‑5 times/week. Ordered fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar per annual adult screening; also repeat CBC, stool routine, tTG‑IgA.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide SOS. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, or melena.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting glucose 92 mg/dL (70‑99).
Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 112 mg/dL (<130), TG 138 mg/dL (<150).
CBC: Hb 13.0 g/L, WBC 6.0, Plt 205.
Stool routine: No pathogens, occult blood negative.
tTG‑IgA: 5 U/mL (<7).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
IBS flare.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Increased abdominal cramping and diarrhoea 3‑4 times/day over past week, associated with stress.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82, weight 57 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Abdomen mildly tender in left lower quadrant, no guarding.
IMPRESSION: IBS exacerbation likely stress‑related. Overweight persists; advise stress‑reduction, regular meals, avoid caffeine.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase loperamide to 2 mg SOS up to 4 doses/day if needed; continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD. Return if fever, bloody stools, severe pain, or dehydration.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Mebeverine hydrochloride 135 mg tablet – BD.
Ispaghula husk 5 g sachet – OD.
Loperamide 2 mg capsule – take up to four capsules after loose stool, not exceeding 16 mg/24h.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Dear Clinic, I’ve been following the low‑FODMAP advice and walking after meals. My bowel movements are more regular now, only occasional urgency. Thank you for the support.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
IBS follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports good control, only mild bloating after heavy meals.
EXAMINATION: BP 135/80, weight 56.5 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Abdomen soft.
IMPRESSION: IBS well managed. Overweight persists; encourage portion control and daily activity.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide SOS as needed. Return if new rectal bleeding, weight loss, fever >39°C, or severe abdominal pain.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for review of IBS and cardiovascular risk on 2026-11-12 at 10:30 am with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03). Please arrive 10 minutes early. Call to reschedule if needed.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Stable IBS, no alarm symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/78, weight 56 kg, BMI 23.3 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: IBS in remission. Overweight per Asian cut‑offs; advise maintain Mediterranean diet, aerobic activity 150 min/week. Ordered fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar as per yearly screen.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide SOS. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, melena, or sudden weight change.
